summary: Checked the current WordPress/ACF/plugin state, every retained SVG attachment and its live ACF attachment-ID relation, frozen-source byte equality, CF7 forms, gateway configuration, empty external-document fields, and representative template output. Twelve RudnikAgro ACF groups are active; WooCommerce, ACF Pro and Contact Form 7 are active; three project CF7 forms exist; 77 SVG attachments are referenced by 80 ACF fields and every mapped SVG exactly matches its frozen source asset by SHA-256. Acceptance is blocked by genuine missing source/provider inputs and also has actionable implementation/security defects.
issues: EDITABLE-001 (critical): functions/support.php globally adds image/svg+xml to upload_mimes for every upload-capable role and provides no upload-time SVG sanitizer. The importer only rejects four obvious byte patterns; it does not protect later ACF replacement uploads. Restrict SVG upload to explicitly authorized roles and sanitize every uploaded SVG without disabling WordPress checks globally.

EDITABLE-002 (blocked): both catalogue PDF attachment fields and both online-reader URL fields are empty because the source contains no files or destinations; product 54/55 download files are empty; product 54 download_icon is empty because node 586:1022 has no retained exact SVG export. Real files/URLs and the exact source SVG are required; no substitute may be fabricated.

EDITABLE-003 (blocked): only the native bacs gateway is enabled. Przelewy24/card/Google Pay/Apple Pay/BLIK/cash-on-delivery credentials and method mapping are not supplied, and no approved existing order/access key exists for the completed-order route. The retained source-dependency records correctly prevent fabricated payment/order state.

EDITABLE-004 (high): the current WordPress site title is Safegold while factory/project.json identifies the actual project as RudnikAgro. Correct the native site identity without changing frozen source references.

EDITABLE-005 (medium): visible source copy is still hardcoded in templates instead of editable WordPress/ACF content, including Czytaj całość in front-page.php, Zobacz więcej in partials/blog-item.php, and Produkty powiązane in single-product.php.

EDITABLE-006 (high): single-product.php renders the five source STAR nodes 429:836–429:840 as a font ★ glyph and renders the inquiry close control as a literal ×. These are static glyph substitutes rather than exact replaceable SVG attachment-ID fields.

EDITABLE-007 (medium): all 77 SVG attachments retain sourceField and sourceAsset metadata and exact source bytes, but none stores an explicit _rudnikagro_source_node value. For semantic filenames such as checkout-card.svg this prevents the required unambiguous source-node/media-ID/ACF-field provenance map.

EDITABLE-008 (blocked): the account-registration dialog source exposes no separate close-glyph node/export. The implementation correctly avoids inventing that control, but an exact exported asset remains required for visual completion.
